head: ryz (< denom. rēz cf. RW 454: Reihe; < Kurd. rêz cf. Ku 641: ‘строй, ряд, шеренга’; cf. Barwar ryz (III), Khan 2008 1171: to stand in a row; to put in a row; Sardarid maryiz, Younasardaroud 108: ordnen)

examples.turoyo: fayəš ko-royəz abšoṯe m-i=dukṯo d-rəzle l-awo u=ḥreno
examples.translation: He began strewing raisins from that place where the other had strewn
examples.raw: fayəš ko-royəz abšoṯe m-i=dukṯo d-rəzle l-awo u=ḥreno ʻHe began strewing raisins from that place where the other had strewnʼ; 518; 44/40;

examples.turoyo: gər-royazno me-larwal m-i=qriṯo ṭlawḥe hul l-i=arʕo
examples.translation: I will be strewing lentils from the outside of the village till the field
examples.raw: gər-royazno me-larwal m-i=qriṯo ṭlawḥe hul l-i=arʕo ʻI will be strewing lentils from the outside of the village till the fieldʼ; 522; 44/70;

examples.turoyo: awwə́l d-nəfqat m-i=qriṯo, g-royazno abšoṯe b-u=darbo. w-talax b-u=šop-awo hul d-moṭat l-gabi!
examples.translation: As soon as you go out from the village I will strew raisins along the way. Follow this track unless you reach me!
examples.raw: awwə́l d-nəfqat m-i=qriṯo, g-royazno abšoṯe b-u=darbo. w-talax b-u=šop-awo hul d-moṭat l-gabi! ‘As soon as you go out from the village I will strew raisins along the way. Follow this track unless you reach me!’; 44/38 [MT];

examples.turoyo: yəmkən hani nfolo nafili me-noše. huwe lo=ko-royəz hawxa əšmo. ašər g-əzzí bəṯr-ani aġ=ġalabe!
examples.translation: Perhaps, these [raisins] dropped out from somebody’s [pocket]. He does not strew so a few [raisins]. I will sure follow [the way where there are] many [raisins]
examples.raw: yəmkən hani nfolo nafili me-noše. huwe lo=ko-royəz hawxa əšmo. ašər g-əzzí bəṯr-ani aġ=ġalabe! ‘Perhaps, these [raisins] dropped out from somebody’s [pocket]. He does not strew so a few [raisins]. I will sure follow [the way where there are] many [raisins]’; 44/47

examples.turoyo: hawo royaz-wo ḥabṯo ḥabṯo, hano u=kačălōk rəzle ġắlabe
examples.translation: That was strewing [raisins] grain by grain, this bald-headed [on the other hand] strewed [raisins] in handfuls
examples.raw: hawo royaz-wo ḥabṯo ḥabṯo, hano u=kačălōk rəzle ġắlabe ʻThat was strewing [raisins] grain by grain, this bald-headed [on the other hand] strewed [raisins] in handfulsʼ; 524; 44/41;

examples.turoyo: aʕ=ʕarše rize ʕal al=luġme ʕloye w taḥtóye-ne
examples.translation: die Zähne sind aufgereiht auf der oberen und der unteren Kinnlade
examples.raw: aʕ=ʕarše rize ʕal al=luġme ʕloye w taḥtóye-ne 'die Zähne sind aufgereiht auf der oberen und der unteren Kinnlade'; 534; 3/35;

examples.turoyo: ga kal kīt abšoṯe rize b-u=darbo
examples.translation: There are raisins scattered along the way
examples.raw: ga kal kīt abšoṯe rize b-u=darbo ‘There are raisins scattered along the way’; 44/44
